title: Mochizuki Honami — Guiding Resolve〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tell me about the things that you like or that make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing Hanano and her brother there together made me realize something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our music brought them together and allowed them to be with someone important to them.
So, how amazing would it be if we could do that for more people...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to bring people together through our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thinking about the things that make you happy, things you like or what you want to do might make the answer you're looking for easier to find.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I definitely feel a little less anxious after talking to Ichika...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What do I want to aspire to with our music...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I still don't really know, but I have to find the answer.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this is the opposite of that other time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? The opposite...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember when I was having trouble sleeping while writing that song for Hanano and her brother?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, Ichika, you didn't stay up all night, did you? Are you sure you're up to this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, I know it's already pretty late, but please make sure to get to bed sooner rather than later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. You're right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, Ichika...
Are the bags under my eyes noticeable?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Only when I'm standing right next to you. Still, people passing by might do a double take.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, sorry. Bringing them up is only going to make you worry about them, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was actually sitting in the back of my mind when I left my house this morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the thing I was much more concerned about took over during my walk to school.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wish I'd thought further ahead about how this might make people worry...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so like you to be more concerned about how others are worrying about you, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, I'm also embarrassed to have these bags under my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Do you think there's some way to quickly get rid of these?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can try searching for that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's see...
“How to remove bags from under your eyes”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
How about this one...?
Improving blood circulation by warming up affected areas apparently works.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Hmm... If only I had one of those heated eye masks they sell at pharmacies...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What else can you warm them with...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're giggling.
Does that mean you came up with a good idea?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A very special one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if you had someone with warm hands help you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm warm and cuddly all year round♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you talking about Saki?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sure she'll be more than happy to share some of her warmth with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're probably right, but asking her to do that might be just as embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
True.
What else is there? Massaging them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All these videos came up, so why don't we try watching a couple together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
